scope: Read-only reconnaissance of data/raw/Paderborn/K001.rar and documentation contained in that archive/workspace. No model training, splitting, preprocessing, or configuration changes were performed.

workspace_documentation.readme_versions.txt: 2016-07-13: update of profile of bearing damage KI03 (correction of mistakes in description of damage geometry)

source_files.inspection_method: bsdtar listing plus temporary extraction to /private/tmp; scipy.io.loadmat and pypdf used for read-only inspection.

documentation_supported_facts.bearing_code: The PDFs call K001 the bearing code. K001 is the identifier represented by this archive.
documentation_supported_facts.measurement_number: The terminal integer is 1 through 20 within each of the four observed N/M/F combinations.

corroborated_by_recorded_channels_not_ex.N15: Representative file records mean speed about 1499.6 min^-1; N09 records about 899.7 min^-1.
corroborated_by_recorded_channels_not_ex.F10: Representative files record mean force about 1026-1042 N; F04 records about 403.6 N.
corroborated_by_recorded_channels_not_ex.M07_vs_M01: M07 representative files record mean torque about 1.20-1.26, while M01 records about 0.64. The local documentation does not define the M token, its units, or the exact intended setpoint mapping.

unknown_without_more_official_documentat: The exact expanded meanings/units of the N, M, and F tokens as filename fields.
Whether the leading K in a code such as K001 or KA01 has a separate semantic meaning beyond being part of the bearing code.
The condition/damage meaning, if any, encoded by letter variants such as KA01.

mat_structure.top_level_variable: Each inspected MAT file has one top-level 1x1 MATLAB struct named exactly as its filename stem, e.g. N15_M07_F10_K001_1.
mat_structure.duration: The representative recordings are 4 seconds; sample counts are consistent with roughly 4 s at their documented rasters, including endpoint samples.

bearing_metadata.condition_status: UNKNOWN from the locally available documentation. The K001 profile is headed 'Profile of rolling bearing damage' but supplies no explicit healthy/damaged status, artificial/real provenance, damage location, damage type, subtype, or geometry.
bearing_metadata.available_categories: No complete bearing-condition taxonomy is available locally. K001 is the only bearing identifier available; healthy, artificial-damage, natural/real-damage, and damage-location/type/subtype classes cannot be established from this archive.

operating_conditions.instrumentation: The measuring log documents motor-current, force, speed, torque, vibration, and temperature instrumentation; detailed device names are retained in the source PDF.

leakage_and_grouping.window_leakage: Randomly assigning windows from a single 4-second recording to different partitions leaks highly correlated waveform, acquisition, operating-condition, and bearing-specific signatures. It can inflate apparent generalization substantially.
leakage_and_grouping.minimum_group: Keep all derived windows from one original MAT recording together.
leakage_and_grouping.recommended_primary_group: Bearing identifier / physical bearing, if the target task is intended to generalize to unseen bearings. All recordings and all windows for that bearing must remain in one partition.
leakage_and_grouping.secondary_grouping_consideration: Measurement/acquisition session and operating condition should be retained as metadata. If a bearing is recorded under multiple operating conditions, those conditions must not create leakage through overlapping windows or repeated recording artifacts.
leakage_and_grouping.reason: Only K001 is available, so there is one independent bearing identity and no valid train/validation/test partition by bearing.
leakage_and_grouping.operating_condition_generalization: Potentially testable only after additional bearings and documented labels are available: hold out one or more N/M/F conditions for testing while ensuring bearing identities are not shared across partitions. With K001 alone it cannot test classification generalization.

additional_archives_needed: Additional bearing archives spanning every organizer-approved target condition/category, with their official bearing-profile PDFs and measuring logs.
Official Paderborn naming and damage-taxonomy documentation defining N/M/F and bearing-code prefixes (including examples such as KA01).
Organizer-approved task statement, fixed split protocol or enough independent bearing IDs to create one, exact mandatory baseline, and primary metric.
unknowns_blocking_task_design: Damage location/type/subtype and label taxonomy for all bearing IDs.
Official Track 1 label scheme, fixed splits, baseline, and primary metric.
Whether the intended signal is vibration only, current only, a defined sensor subset, or another representation.
Whether file naming codes have a formally documented unit/setpoint legend.
